value.en: Beginning with one drop beneath the ice, follow a river through cloud forest, canyon and estuary—and watch it shape a continent.

value.zh: 在虚构的维尔德山脉，冰层每天向后退去几厘米。一条没有名字的细流，从黑色岩脊间第一次显出方向。
value.en: In the fictional Verde range, ice retreats by centimetres each day. Between dark ridges, an unnamed stream finds its first direction.

value.zh: 水位落下后，岩壁上的浅色线仍标记着上一季的峰值。地貌像一份缓慢书写、无法擦除的档案。
value.en: When the water falls, pale lines on the rock still mark last season’s peak. The land is an archive written slowly and never erased.

value.zh: 每条支流都连接着迁徙、繁殖与觅食的时间表。改变一段流速，可能同时改写数百种生物的季节。
value.en: Every tributary links schedules of migration, breeding and feeding. Change one current and the seasons of hundreds of species may shift with it.

value.en: Water returning from leaves to clouds forms an invisible river above the continent, drawing distant ground into the same cycle.

value.en: Silt, salt and tide redraw channels through mangroves. The journey does not end; one river simply becomes a thousand openings.
